snippet.title: Into the Crypt Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1879270/Into_the_Crypt/

About Into the Crypt:

Slay enemies in a cut-throat 3D roguelike deck builder where you travel into the depths of an ancient crypt, uncover artifacts and mysterious events along the way.

Choose from one of several classes, each with their own unique and large set of specialized cards. Brew potions, fight bizarre and strange enemies, collect treasures and use keys to unlock deeper crypt secrets.

Do you have what it takes to survive the Crypt?
